coordination: Source-pinned handoff for Nash/Maxwell/Kepler via parent intake; no agreement or delivery receipt from other workers inferred.

minimum_partition_claim.reason: 58 is first passing retained analytical repartition screen, not a proof of legal owner assignment or manufacturable minimum. This is one candidate for joint review, not permission to sweep or build.

owned_packing_evidence.scope: S66 diagnostic only, notS58 geometry transfer; all prior collisions/failures preserved

ownership_grain.residual_scope: Includes compute/control/wires/margin; not pure measured compute and not current hardened RNE/WAKE abstract
ownership_grain.retained_source_parameters: NB2/PP1 complete pair with shared compute/control retained; paired halves not separated without equivalent golden/source proof

primary_lever: Fewer complete weight-plus-adjacent-compute pairs per die; more dies;4096 depth unchanged; no independent sweeps

required_ownership_bound_before_selectio.Kepler: Hold existing service ports/finite buffers/leased lifetimes; bind exact native field/collector/HBM/link cuts and pin/OBS/clockPG/via exclusions to candidate addresses/owners.
required_ownership_bound_before_selectio.Maxwell: Keep exact reduction ordering and source program. Bind all operator substage boundaries, producer publication/retire/return lifetimes; explicitly reject if indivisible owner cannot fit.
required_ownership_bound_before_selectio.Nash: Map every actual stage/operator/bank owner and all nonexpert weights into integer complete-pair assignments. Supply largest operator and reduction subtree that cannot cross a stage; compare its exact pair/port demand to this candidate. Coarse worst-die totals/fractional macro fractions are insufficient.

TP_collectives.collective_latency_required: Rebind exact golden subtrees/bytes/lifetimes under repartition; unchangedTP does not prove unchanged collective traffic or latency. No stagehop multiplication byTP.

separate_latency_prices.intensity: Per-die weight capacity/MACs percycle decrease; same element MACs/byte unchanged.
